barrier_precision_rule: Raw maximum is retained. Numerical resolution uses128*machine_epsilon*n*max(1,maxabs(field)); this is a conservative machine-precision diagnostic, not measurement uncertainty or a statistical threshold.
centered_loss_interpretation: Whole-field constant/codon/T losses compare shape after separately centering T and V; validation centering uses held-out values to define this diagnostic, so these are not out-of-sample level predictions.
response_scale_limit: A codon-additive residual on log-count-ratio scale does not distinguish molecular interaction from a nonlinear response to a latent additive field.
uncertainty: descriptive finite-library reproducibility only; noCI/pvalue/noiseceiling or independent-biological-unit claim; no pooling of9scenarios as independent samples
